# opnsense_bind_in_view_domain (Resource)

Shares an existing primary or secondary BIND zone from an earlier view using BIND in-view.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) Zone name shared from the source view.
- `source_view_id` (String) Source view UUID containing the primary or secondary zone.
- `view_id` (String) Target view UUID. The target view must be ordered after source_view_id.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
